name: @finance/schemas
description: Validation rules shared by the API and the web client
//sideEffects: Pure declarations: every module here is bounds, patterns and schema objects, with no I/O and nothing to run on import. Saying so lets a bundler drop what an app does not import — apps/web reads only limits, patterns and enums, so this is what keeps `fields.ts` (and the Zod build it pulls in) out of the client bundle.
